name: RISC-V Adventure
tagline: This is a quest through the layers of computer architecture
blurb: Players must master various components to eventually understand and build the "Great and Terrible" Multi-cycle Processor.
description:
Players must master various components to eventually understand and build the "Great and Terrible" Multi-cycle Processor. 31 Levels across 8 Educational Chapters:

• Register - The basics of data storage.

• Multiplexer - The art of selection.

• ALU - The core of calculations.

• Memory - Where instructions and data reside.

• Extender - Preparing data for processing.

• Register File - Managing multiple registers.

• Single-Cycle Processor - Putting it all together in a single cycle. (Work in Progress)

• Multi-Cycle Processor - The ultimate goal!

Companion System: Meet Charlie, your digital assistant. She provides hints, explains theory, and allows players to choose between deep-dive explanations or jumping straight into the action.

Interactive Learning: Concepts are taught through gameplay mechanics rather than just passive reading.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
